evidence:
Workbook Quality Checks row 16 and its identical internal row require inputs and ask without the finished deliverable. The frozen task/environment/Dockerfile:14-23 copies only instructions/ and assets/, then creates /app with one committed .gitkeep; it is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile. All seven copied files were read: environment/assets/seed_data.json:1-4 is an empty snippets collection and scope note; the six notes are product/runtime prose without implementation, schema, starter UI, or application API route list. integration.md:5 names only the required launch/health contract and expressly leaves routes/layout open; policy.md:5-7 leaves interface/API choices to the builder. A normalized 12-word-overlap and exact criterion-ID scan against all 94 criterion blocks found no copied criterion text or IDs in the notes.

Built the exact frozen environment as qc-coldwater-row16:history-hardening-r1, image sha256:d6bd1b069a0cf51e6ae1d5ba95b3cdc98367bf5692d45f1bb26288e30203a082. The build and an isolated --network none disposable-container inspection both exited 0. /app entries were .git and .gitkeep; git ls-files listed only .gitkeep; all Git objects contained only the root commit, tree and empty .gitkeep blob; worktree status was clean. /solution, /tests, /app/server.js and /app/package.json were absent. The six /instructions files and sole /assets/seed_data.json matched the frozen hashes exactly. Raw commands/results are in qc/runs/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/row16-agent-image-proof.json, SHA256 65d8f637224e343972efc95580f54e3f65c188233201a92f954282336b29d09c.

Adversarial reasoning: a weak builder attempting to copy a preinstalled completed app, recover it from Git history, or serve the seed has no implementation to copy; the seed contains no snippets or UI. A conforming builder choosing different internal schemas/routes/control labels still receives the required product behavior and no leaked reference architecture. These are boundary checks, not measured app scores. Frozen manifest checks verified 1,384 task files and 34 rules files with zero mismatches, and current policy hashes matched. All 21 raw-evidence-index artifact hashes matched; their scripted golden evidence does not establish a configured-judge result and is not relied on for this row.
